# docs-core

> The Rust docs pipeline core (ADR-0004 §2.5): CommonMark+GFM to static
> HTML with astro-island-compatible island emission, so a Rust-rendered
> shell hydrates the estate's existing SolidJS bundles.

docs-core is the estate's consolidation point for documentation rendering:
what Tachyon (16 crates), `docs-pipeline`, and the eight `starlight-*`
plugins did in three languages, behind one L2 crate with one external
dependency. The extension program around it adds symbol-anchored includes,
execution witnesses, Lean proof certificates, and client search, composed
by `docs-compiler`.

## Read first

- [README](https://github.com/WyattAu/docs-core/blob/main/README.md): the island seam, M1 scope, truth table
- [SPEC](https://github.com/WyattAu/docs-core/blob/main/SPEC.md): the extension program - proof-carrying docs, symbol anchors, witnesses, client search (CURRENT)
- [Plan ledger](https://github.com/WyattAu/docs-core/blob/main/docs/plans/hypermedium-program.md): milestone status and findings (done)

## Sibling crates

- [docs-compiler](https://github.com/WyattAu/docs-compiler): the L3 CLI resolving all four directive kinds
- [docs-symbols](https://github.com/WyattAu/docs-symbols): symbol-anchored source extraction (REQ-S)
- [docs-witness](https://github.com/WyattAu/docs-witness): deterministic WASI execution witnesses (REQ-W)
- [docs-proof](https://github.com/WyattAu/docs-proof): Lean proof certificates (REQ-P)
- [docs-search](https://github.com/WyattAu/docs-search): client search index, FST + roaring (REQ-Q)

## Machine-readable

- [Cargo.toml](https://github.com/WyattAu/docs-core/blob/main/Cargo.toml): crate manifest, layer declaration (L2)
- [estate.yml](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/blob/main/estate.yml): the estate registry of record
